ruleDefinitions.name: Potential PowerShell Execution Policy Tampering - ProcCreation
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects changes to the PowerShell execution policy registry key in order to bypass signing requirements for script execution from the CommandLine

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\ShellIds\\\\Microsoft\\\.PowerShell\\\\ExecutionPolicy.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Policies\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\PowerShell\\\\ExecutionPolicy.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*Bypass.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*RemoteSigned.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Unrestricted.*")))
